tasks.T1_linear: sklearn make_classification; binary, 10 features, 6 informative, 1 cluster/class, class_sep=1.0
tasks.T2_nonlinear: sklearn make_circles in 2 features; 8 independent standard-normal nuisance features
tasks.T3_interactions: 10 independent standard-normal features; label sign(X0*X1 + X2*X3)

data.seed_derivation: numpy SeedSequence; independent task/split streams derived from each campaign seed
data.initial_agent_training: all three models receive the same pooled 6000 labeled examples (2000 from each task); no task-to-agent specialization is injected; all agents are scored on all three tasks

transfer.method: Bernoulli soft-target distillation, mixed with true labels
transfer.receiver_update: warm-start LogisticRegression refit; soft Bernoulli targets represented by two weighted rows per input

organization.tie_break: lexicographic in fixed agent order [A1, A2, A3]
organization.O0: initial-model validation optimum, frozen for C0 and C1
organization.O1: post-transfer validation optimum, used for C2 and C3
organization.test_use: evaluation only; never used for model or assignment selection

conditions.C3: post-transfer six-permutation validation reference; identical to C2 by the supplied definition
conditions.control_1_and_2: identical hard-label refit of A1 on T3 with the same labels/data/optimization cap and no donor probabilities; recorded once because no difference is specified
conditions.control_3: same distillation with donor probabilities permuted across T3 training rows

statistics.unit: seed; paired contrasts use the same generated data/test set within seed
statistics.H3_rule: compatible only if the 95% CI for individual A1 T3 accuracy change is wholly above 0 and the 95% CI for C1-C0 collective accuracy is wholly below 0
statistics.reorganization_contrast: C2-C1; secondary; positive indicates recovery, not necessarily full recovery
